extDescription.message: Control the media playing in your browser: volume boost, equalizer with presets, loop, MP4/MP3 download with yt-dlp, frame capture and source link.

cmdScreenshot.message: Capture the frame of the video on screen

noMediaHint.message: Start a video or a sound, it will show up here.

restricted.message: Media+ can't act on this page

restrictedHint.message: Chrome pages and the Web Store are protected.

volumeHelp.message: 100 % (the middle) is the site's normal volume, beyond it boosts the tab. Double-click to reset.

abLoop.message: A-B loop: click at the start, then at the end

abSetA.message: Start set at $1, click again at the end

openSource.message: Open the source in a new tab

noSource.message: No source found for this media

recordStarted.message: Recording while it plays, the file is saved at the end

recordInstead.message: Record it while it plays instead

viaBrowser.message: Direct file: saved by Chrome right away.

viaYtdlp.message: Downloaded by yt-dlp, then saved by Chrome.

viaRecord.message: Streamed media: recorded while it plays (MP4, real time).

viaRecordAudio.message: Without yt-dlp the sound is recorded while it plays, as M4A.

ytdlpStarted.message: yt-dlp is downloading, follow it at the top

mseSource.message: Streams loaded by the player, from its CDN:

noStreams.message: No stream detected yet: let the media play a few seconds.

boostHelp.message: Up to $1 % for the whole tab

presetHelp_harman.message: Bass of the Harman target, the audiophile reference for headphones

presetHelp_bass.message: Fuller bass, the muddy 400 Hz cut back

presetHelp_bassPlus.message: Strong bass for music and headphones

presetHelp_music.message: Bass and treble lifted, a bit like a loudness button

presetHelp_clarity.message: More detail and air, for dull sound

presetHelp_laptop.message: Bass small speakers can play, voices brought forward

presetHelp_night.message: Quiet and loud parts evened out, voices forward

limiterHelp.message: Leaves headroom for the EQ and catches peaks

nightHelp.message: Brings quiet and loud parts closer

mixerRestored.message: Your last mixer settings are on

enhancerHelp.message: Adds the harmonics of the bass: you hear it even on small speakers

normalizeHelp.message: Same loudness from one video to the next

vocalHelp.message: Works on voices mixed in the centre, like most songs

pitchHelp.message: Higher or lower without changing the speed

mixerNote.message: The mixer processes all the sound of this tab. Chrome shows a sharing icon on the tab while it's on.

locationHelp.message: Chrome remembers the last folder you picked

hostMissing.message: Chrome can't run yt-dlp by itself, even if it's on your PC: install the small companion once (host\install.cmd)

hostWrongId.message: Installed for another copy of the extension: run host\install.cmd again

hostNoYtdlp.message: The companion is there but yt-dlp moved: run host\install.cmd again

hostTimeout.message: The companion did not answer, try Check again

engineHelp.message: Simple files always go through Chrome

sendCookiesHelp.message: Gives yt-dlp this site's cookies, for private or members-only media

defaultSpeedHelp.message: Applied to every media that starts

rememberMixerHelp.message: Applied when you open Media+ on the tab

errGone.message: This media is no longer on the page

errProtected.message: This video is protected by the site, capture it while it's visible in the main page

errOffscreen.message: Scroll the video into view first

errNoTracks.message: Nothing to record yet: start the media first

errGesture.message: Chrome refused: click the video on the page once, then try again

errCapture.message: The sound of this page can't be processed

errCaptureBusy.message: The sound of this tab is already captured by another extension
